node.statement: Taking C_co=C_corner and e_co=min(e_corner,e_cmp), where e_cmp is the universal threshold supplied by the validated amplification dependencies, and applying node 1.1 to the amplified data from node 1.2 proves ||A dot B-AB|| <= C_co*e*||A||||B|| uniformly in n.
